info.name: Google Chrome Management App Details Telemetry Devices API

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. Maximum and default value is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token to specify next page in the result set.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter to restrict results. Supports filtering by serial number, device ID, org unit, and timestamps. Example: serial_number=ABC123 AND timestamp>2024-01-01T00:00:00Z

params.name: readMask
params.description: Fields to include in the response. Use this to request specific telemetry data categories such as cpuInfo, cpuStatusReport, memoryInfo, memoryStatusReport, networkInfo, osUpdateStatus, storageInfo, storageStatusReport, batteryInfo, batteryStatusReport, networkDiagnosticsReport, and more.

items.docs: Lists all telemetry devices for a customer. Retrieves device-level telemetry data including hardware specifications, operating system version, CPU, memory, storage, network interfaces, battery status, and peripheral information for managed ChromeOS devices.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: Unique identifier of the telemetry device.

params.name: readMask
params.description: Fields to include in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a single telemetry device by its resource name. Returns detailed telemetry data for the specified managed ChromeOS device.
